method: reverse-distillation: frozen DINOv3 ViT-B/16 teacher -> OCBE bottleneck (trainable) -> transformer decoder student (trainable); anomaly = Topk per-patch reconstruction discrepancy
loss: Topk per-patch cosine distance (top-5 hardest patches), summed over 4 taps; NO CLS/LL term
protocol: one-class PER-SCENE (same as MADViT): each scene MERGES all its sequences' train sub-videos into one model (7 scenes total; e.g. crossroads=seq1+2+3) -> eval on the scene's merged test (global concat AUC)
recipe_note: optimization recipe aligned to the proven MADViT recipe (AdamW + wd5e-2 + OneCycleLR + bs64 + workers8). img=256/ImageNet-norm/architecture are deliberate RD+DINOv3 choices.
